items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In the same year, ’78, that you started Ain’t Misbehavin, you also did the I’m Old Fashioned date with Watanabe.

ctx.x: I found that interesting, and I wonder how you’re able to organize you mind. In the same year, ’78, that you started Ain’t Misbehavin, you also did the I’m Old Fashioned date with Watanabe.
You did the Tip Toe Tapdance. You did a Grooving High date for Muse. That had Charlie Raus and Thad on it.
